taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: etcd client authentication and key-prefix authorization
controls.source_trace: Follow verified client identity into effective key-prefix operations and distinguish server transport trust from enabled application authorization.
controls.implementation_branch: Confirm authentication is enabled and which certificate or token maps to the effective user and roles. Prefix range permissions depend on the actual byte interval, not a human-readable prefix label. A TLS connection is not an authorization check; use tiny owned keys and inspect both point and range operations without dumping the keyspace.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an isolated etcd fixture with synthetic prefixes and two owned clients; compare rightful read/write and a restricted prefix operation.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: TLS connection success is not key authorization, and endpoint metadata is not confidential key-value exposure.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind client identities and prefix grants consistently across enabled interfaces and verify intended operations.
